perspectives.title: Bank of England Chief Economist: 'Interest rates are falling too fast'
perspectives.snippet: Top comment · The effect of rate cuts and raises has always been delayed. In industrial countries it was 6-9 months. With the immense rise of services I've heard more and more economists talk about 1,5-2 years before the full impact of interest rate changes would be fully integrated in the economy. It thus makes sense to not make rapid changes (except when facing a crisis for example) to avoid lowering/raising rates too much.
